title: Unmasking and Quantifying Racial Bias of Large Language Models in Medical Report Generation

bias_targets.methodology: Counterfactual race substitution in patient profiles (injecting White, Black, Hispanic, and Asian identities) to analyze disparities in LLM-generated medical reports, specifically evaluating differences in paraphrased patient history, generated diagnoses, treatment recommendations, projected healthcare costs, hospitalization durations, and survival rate predictions.
